# NAVCORE-SoOP — pin map

**Generated by `tools/gen_pinmap.py` — do not hand-edit.**
Sources: `firmware/reference/MatekH743-hwdef.dat` + `tools/navcore_deltas.json`.
Regenerate after changing either: `python3 tools/gen_pinmap.py`

## There is ONE board

This project has **a single PCB**. What older notes call "Rev A" and "Rev B" are two
*firmware configurations* of that one board, not two boards:

| configuration | what it is |
|---|---|
| **default** | bit-identical to MatekH743 across all 75 assigned pins, so stock ArduPilot `MatekH743` binaries run **unmodified** |
| **SoOP** | the same board with **5 pins repurposed in firmware**, plus a tuner wired to pads that already exist |

All 5 repurposed pins are MatekH743 functions this airframe does not have, and each
already reaches a pad — so **there is no PCB change between the two**. Switching
configuration is a reflash, not a fabrication run.

## SoOP configuration — the repurposed pins

| Pin | MatekH743 use | NAVCORE-SoOP use | Why it is free |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PC4` | PRESSURE_SENS | **SOOP_I_ADC** | no airspeed sensor on a quad. ADC1 ch4 - I channel |
| `PA4` | BATT2_VOLTAGE_SENS | **SOOP_Q_ADC** | single battery. ADC2 ch18 - Q channel, sampled simultaneously with ADC1 |
| `PC5` | RSSI_ADC | **SOOP_RSSI_ADC** | RSSI comes over CRSF telemetry. Reused for MAX2112 analogue RSSI/AGC readback |
| `PA7` | BATT2_CURRENT_SENS | **SPARE_ADC** | single battery. Left as a test point / spare ADC1 ch7 |
| `PE10` | UART7_CTS | **PPS_SYNC_IN** | hardware time sync from companion; flow control unused at 921600 over 5cm |

## MatekH743 features deliberately not populated

- MAX7456 OSD
- BATT2 monitor
- airspeed
- analogue RSSI
- USART3/GPS2

Total pins assigned: **75**. Alternate-function pins: **1** (PC7).
